verdict.rationale: Exporting chat history and account data is a fair trust-control question for a consumer AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an export or data-download capability: the help topics cover search, memory, scheduled tasks, skills and agents, and the code docs cover the CLI, API keys and models, but none of them mention exporting.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data
